name: Ant Kingdom Rush 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Ant Kingdom Rush is a strategic runner where you lead a growing ant army through dangerous paths, collect more ants, pass multiplier gates, avoid deadly traps, and defeat rival colonies in big final battles.Build your swarm, choose the best route, and reach the finish line with enough power to conquer the enemy kingdom.
